packages.va_adaptation: Project-owned native 1024-byte-sector FAT12 maintenance for the 2HD profile in 80 or NEC-compatible 77 cylinders; CHKDSK is read-only; FORMAT formats every B: track through INT 80h AH=03h (mode 23h), verifies sectors and writes a fresh volume, or with /Q rewrites only metadata on a valid native BPB; SYS transfers selected native system files and boot code to B: while keeping B:'s BPB geometry and label; media binding uses the normal DOS media check (INT 21h AH=36h)
tests: synthetic FAT/volume/FORMAT/SYS host fixtures for 80 and 77 cylinders
M20 VAEG VA/VA2: blank-disk FORMAT (80 and /T:77), CHKDSK, SYS, boot and write/readback of the SYS-output disks, redirected CHKDSK A: and SYS output to A:

packages.va_adaptation: FreeDOS-version/layout-checked AH=52h MCB-chain reader; MZ maximum allocation equals minimum at EXEC, while the OW 1.9 runtime may grow its own heaps; after priming stdout, the documented near/far heap-shrink APIs release only unused own heap tails before observation; no direct BIOS calls
tests: synthetic bounded MCB and runtime trim/failure tests
matched VA/VA2 checked guest MCB reports and independent observer-only footprint comparison; physical/outside-arena view unavailable
